---
title: Callout footnote regression
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
filters:
  - delayed-footnotes.lua
---

Outside before.[^before]

::: {.callout-note}
## Several notes
First.[^one] Second.[^two] Third.[^three]
:::

Outside after.[^after]

::: {.callout-tip}
## Another box
Fourth.[^four]
:::

![Two figure notes.[^figone][^figtwo]](figure.png){#fig-check width=1cm}

[^figone]: First figure note text.
[^figtwo]: Second figure note text.

[^before]: Outside before text.
[^one]: First distinct note text.
[^two]: Second distinct note text.
[^three]: Third distinct note text, with **bold** and $x^2$.

    A second paragraph in the third note.
[^after]: Outside after text.
[^four]: Fourth distinct note text.
